description: Fourth year of secondary English (baccalauréat, common core for all six streams): forty-two lessons from Skills for Life — holidaying and tourism, education and lifelong learning, inventive minds and scientific achievement, and life issues from consumerism to the world of work, through reading, listening, speaking and writing, with past habits, the present perfect, reported speech, the passive, the subjunctive, inversion after negative adverbials, conditionals, parallelism, clauses of contrast and relative clauses
